# Hello, Lumen

Lumen began as a weekend project. This post is a page of the site, with
its own preview picture.

<!-- https://lumen.example/docs -->
# Documentation

Lumen is a small library. Start with [getting started](getting-started.md),
then read about [routing](guides/routing.md).

<!-- https://lumen.example/docs/getting-started -->
# Getting started

Add the package:

```yaml
dependencies:
  lumen: ^1.0.0
```

Then read the [routing guide](guides/routing.md#paths).

<!-- https://lumen.example/docs/guides/routing -->
# Routing

A page has an address. Without a front matter, the first heading is the
page's title.

## Paths

`/docs/guides/routing` is this file, `guides/routing.md`. Back to the
[documentation](../index.md).
